question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c73f3a2cdb08de146aefbf144f5c1472b572774f34988b08e907fe7f94dfb6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: The pattern involves a diagonal swap of the outer corner elements along with a reversal of the sequence of elements inside the central circle.**

From the first pair, we observe that the triangle and square interchange positions while the inner letters AB become BA, indicating a reversal of sequence inside the circle.

Applying the same rule to the second pair, the square at the top-left swaps with the circle at the top-right, and the symbols inside the circle reverse their order accordingly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6981217011192479ff8fc0220a5795e462c94224c10e125133292da20ffe6c80.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
